The '''Festival of the Wisties''', also known as the '''Wistie Fest''', was a favorite holiday celebrated by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and the [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. The festival featured a [[Wistie Dance]] and the baking of [[Wistie Fest pie]].

In preparation for one particular festival, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] volunteered to help the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] prepare for the celebration. The two retrieved items such as fungus from a [[brillibab tree]], a [[gwanda gourd]], [[starchain]]s, [[Rainbow berry|rainbow berries]], and a feather from a [[Lantern bird/Legends|lantern bird]]. At the celebration, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] proclaimed it to be the best Wistie Fest ever.
